table: State Individual Income Tax Rates and Brackets, as of January 1, 2025 (single and married filing jointly)
title: 2025 State Income Tax Rates and Brackets
universe: State individual income taxes on wages and salaries
geography: 50 states and the District of Columbia, keyed by postal code
limits: The law in force on January 1, 2025. Acts enacted later in 2025 but made retroactive to January 1 (for example Georgia, Idaho, Utah and Maryland) were not law on January 20, 2025 and are not in this table.
Territories are not in this table; their own income taxes keep the 2026 research rows.
Personal exemptions and credits are kept as the page's text; the withholding engine reads the single schedule and standard deduction only.
A standard deduction shown as a credit or n.a. is recorded as null with the page's words in standardDeductionNote.
